headline: Approved an e-bike and micromobility safety policy, with changes pending, and several school policies in Section J.
summary: Police said they are concerned about safety and do not want an e-bike ban. Officials said the city has jurisdiction over roads and sidewalks, and that registration is not feasible for administration. Several school policies in Section J were passed, while others remain on hold for review.
decisions: Approved the e-bike and micromobility safety policy, pending changes, 3-0.
Passed school admission policy JF, with Admin JF-1 residency enforcement to be done by the district.
Would not recommend policy JFABC, on 9/26.
Passed policy JH on 9/25; the handbook may change as a result.
Kept the current policy JICA on 9/26.
Continued the hold on policy JIH, pending legal review of backpack searches.
Passed policies JJF and JJF-R on 10/2.

decision_evidence.quote: MOTION: Member Keegan made a motion to approve the policy pending the changes discussed by the policy subcommittee. Member McCarthy Sirois seconded the motion. VOTE: PASSED 3-0
a. JF: School Admission PASSED i. Admin JF-1 Residency Enforcement policy 1. Will be done by district
b. JFABC: HOLD contingent on title i. 9/26 WON'T RECOMMEND
c. JH: Hold for admin review i. 9/25 PASSED *handbook may change as a result
d. JI: HOLD for questions about rights listed and why those are the only rights listed i. 9/25 PASSED
e. JIC: HOLD for admin review i. 9/26 PASSED
f. JICA: HOLD; there is a plan to move forward on collecting data (Crown Act) i. 9/26 KEEP current policy
g. JICJ: HOLD for more review, specifically loophole on not using technology in Schools i. 10/2 PASSED
h. JICK: Hold for admin review i. 10/2 PASSED
i. JIH: Hold for legal review on backpack searches i. Continue HOLD
k. JJA: HOLD for “curriculum language" i. 10/2 PASSED
l. JJF and JJF-R: Hold for Business Office review i. 10/2 PASSED
m. JL: Holding for further review i. 10/2 PASSED
o. JLCD: Hold for review by our nurses i. 10/2 PASSED
p. JLCDC: Hold for review from our nurses i. 10/2 PASSED
